name: Theldurin the Lost
summary: Theldurin the Lost is a reclusive, half-mad dwarf wandering the scorched expanses of the Badlands. Formerly aligned with the insidious Twilight's Hammer cult, he fled their ranks with stolen sacred relics after realizing the horror of their designs.

sections.title: A Mind Fractured by Darkness
sections.body: Perched in the barren hills of the Badlands, clutching bags of explosives in wild paranoia, Theldurin is far more than a simple mad hermit. He was once an initiate of the Twilight's Hammer cult. When the sinister cabal sought to awaken a primordial elemental power trapped beneath the earth, Theldurin recoiled in terror, rejected their mad teachings, and fled into the desert. He carried with him the Scroll of Myzrael, desperate to prevent his former masters from unleashing an ancient horror upon the world. Though the escape cost him his sanity, his defiance dealt a serious blow to the cult's plans.

sections.title: A Desperate Countermeasure
sections.body: Survival in the wastes proved bitter. Enraged earth elementals ambushed Theldurin and tore his stolen scroll to pieces, scattering the fragments across the dust. Now besieged by paranoia and haunted by visions of an impending doom slumbering beneath the surface, the crazed dwarf seeks ancient texts—the Tablet of Ryun'eh and Yagyin's Digest—hoping to uncover long-buried lore. Rather than allow the cult to free the elemental princess Myzrael at the height of her fury, Theldurin plots to force her premature summoning so she can be defeated and bound once again.

faq.answer: Theldurin is a mad dwarven hermit hiding in the Badlands. He is a former member of the Twilight's Hammer cult who stole their ritual secrets and fled into the wilderness to stop them from unleashing a dangerous power.

faq.q: Why is Theldurin hiding in the Badlands?
faq.answer: He is on the run from the Twilight's Hammer. After stealing the Scroll of Myzrael from the cult, he took refuge in the remote, sun-baked canyons of the Badlands to stay ahead of the cultists hunting him down.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Myzrael?
faq.answer: It is an arcane parchment holding the ritual knowledge required to release Myzrael, an ancient, corrupted elemental entity trapped deep beneath Arathi. Theldurin stole it so the Twilight's Hammer could not complete their summoning, though local elementals later shredded the document into pieces.

faq.q: What does Theldurin want to do with Myzrael?
faq.answer: Knowing the bindings on the creature are weakening, Theldurin seeks to summon Myzrael prematurely before she gathers her full strength. By forcing her forth weakened, adventurers can banish and re-seal her beneath the crust before the Twilight's Hammer can master her power.

angles.text: Seeing a fellow son of Ironforge reduced to raving paranoia in a wasteland is tragic, but his refusal to bow to dark cults reveals enduring dwarven stubbornness.
Theldurin threatens approaching strangers with a pack brimming with blastpowder, exhibiting an unpredictable reliance on volatile explosives.
